observed_error: ValueError: Project version may affect generated production source
cause: The preparer asserted one occurrence of VERSION, overlooking cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16). There are two: the CMake minimum and the project version. This was a source-check assertion error, not an engine/build/probe failure.
correction: Require exactly the two genuine VERSION occurrences while retaining the exact one-line CMake diff and no configure_file guard.
